key_insight: CloudCons shows that better zero-shot forecasting does not automatically yield better cloud consolidation decisions, and quantile choice is a key control knob for balancing efficiency and reliability.
engineering_relevance: For cloud operators, the benchmark turns model selection into an end-to-end deployment question by measuring whether forecasts actually improve consolidation outcomes.
method: Built CloudCons, an end-to-end benchmark for forecast-then-optimize cloud resource consolidation.
Curated workloads from Huawei Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Google Borg with diverse patterns including diurnal, bursty, and noisy behavior.
Evaluated statistical, deep learning, and foundation models using decision-oriented metrics beyond prediction error.
evidence_signal: The benchmark combines high-quality multi-cloud datasets with extensive zero-shot evaluation to compare forecasting accuracy against downstream consolidation utility.
watch_item: High forecasting accuracy alone is not sufficient; predictive quantiles must be carefully calibrated or the system may trade away service reliability.
paper_title: CloudCons: A Comprehensive End-to-End Benchmark for Cloud Resource Consolidation
